records.category: audit finding: unreconciled government accounts at the central bank and unreconciled public debt records it manages
records.people: Central Bank of Belize and Treasury officials (unnamed)
records.summary: The Auditor General of Belize reported for the 2011/2012 financial year that the Treasury could not show that 25 bank accounts held by the Central Bank of Belize on behalf of the Government of Belize had been reconciled for the audited period. The same report found that the Commonwealth Secretariat public debt recording system managed by the Central Bank of Belize did not reconcile with the Accountant General's financial statements, and that interest payments recorded by the Central Bank differed from the payments recorded in the government's Smart Stream system. No amounts were given for these findings.
records.source_title: Report of the Auditor General 2011-2012 (Office of the Auditor General, Belize)
records.quote: interest payments recorded by the Central Bank differed from the payments recorded in Smart Stream

parties.party: Office of the Auditor General of Belize

records.category: public accounts committee finding: material differences between central bank balances and government records
records.people: Maria Rodriguez (Auditor General of Belize); Teresita Miranda (Accountant General of Belize)
records.summary: The Joint Public Accounts Committee of Belize's National Assembly, reporting on the Auditor General's report for April 2016 to March 2017, listed as a priority area 'Significant material differences between Central Bank and SmartStream balances', with discrepancies totalling 42 million, 19 million, 3 million and 1.4 million dollars. At the Committee's hearings in March 2026 Auditor General Maria Rodriguez said that not even the Central Bank accounts were being reconciled, and referred to differences noted between confirmation letters received from the Central Bank and the government's records. The Committee recorded that the 19,489,652.02 dollar difference shown for the Debt Service Escrow Account was a typographical error with no actual difference, which the Auditor General confirmed.
records.source_title: Report from the Joint Public Accounts Committee on the Report of the Auditor General for the Year April 2016 to March 2017 (National Assembly of Belize)
records.quote: Significant material differences between Central Bank and SmartStream balances

parties.party: Joint Public Accounts Committee, National Assembly of Belize
